coverage_questions: The paper documents batch-level constrained QA, batch-level open-ended QA, cell-level reasoning, batch-level answer-only prediction, and cell-level answer-only prediction. The atlas configuration counts do not specify how every route count maps to these named settings; all paper-documented model variants and explicit routes are represented here, while any additional atlas-only distinctions remain unresolved.

The paper does not identify the tokenizer, vocabulary, segmentation details, special tokens, padding behavior for the external LLM APIs, or exact serialized token sequence received by the zero-shot models.
The paper does not establish literal field order for baseline prompts; their graph retains documented dependencies while leaving serialization order unspecified.
The paper does not state whether single-cell prompts retain every batch-level metadata field or only the donor context relevant to the individual cell.

The paper documents the standardized prompt across reasoning distillation, SFT, and RL, but does not establish target-token teacher forcing, loss masks, chat-role serialization, or the exact tokenizer receipt for those training phases.

The paper states that o1 generates eight candidate responses per distillation input and that GRPO uses five rollouts per training prompt, but the internal response-sampling and policy-distribution representations are not specified.
